name: Oblivhal
summary: The beast that keeps count: every time three Humans charge together, something comes back.

nexusRequirement.label: Nexus requirement
nexusRequirement.text: You control at least 4 Human Entities. Discard an Entity card, then flip.

faceA.name: Oblivhal

keyword.name: Fury
keyword.rules: d20 ≥ 13 before every action · failure −1 HP

effect.text: The first time each of your turns at least 3 Human Entities you control have attacked, you gain 2 HP.

gladeCall.name: Call of the Glade
gladeCall.text: look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a Human Entity among them and add it to your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck.

chargeOrder.name: Charge Order
chargeOrder.text: attacking Human Entities you control get +1 Power until end of turn.

faceA.flavor: It does not lead the charge. It counts it, and remembers who came back.

faceB.name: Return of the Heir

heirAscension.text: If Rhen, Heir of Vhal Astra is on your Front, put it into the Abyss. You can no longer play Rhen, Heir of Vhal Astra for the rest of the game.

effect.text: The first time each of your turns at least 3 Human Entities you control have attacked, you gain 2 HP and draw a card, then discard a card.

heirStep.name: Heir's Step
heirStep.text: the next Human Entity you play this turn costs 1 less Flux.

callOfSeven.name: Call of the Seven
callOfSeven.text: reveal the top 7 cards of your deck. Among them you may put a Human Entity and one other non-Human permanent onto your Front. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck.

returnToFront.name: Return to the Front
returnToFront.text: you may put a Human Entity from your hand onto your Front without paying its Flux cost. That Entity gains Surge until end of turn, and the next Human Entities that attack this turn get +1 Power until end of turn.

faceB.flavor: The heir never returns alone: everyone who waited returns with him.
